plugins.description: Make Claude a professional editor. Beat-synced gaming montages, vlog jump cuts and word-by-word captions, ranked Shorts from long videos, videos made from scratch with /create, a hand-tracked avatar, and edits that follow what you said while filming. Exports up to 4K for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and YouTube, plus Premiere and Resolve timelines.
